verses.english: This was said by the Buddha, the Perfected One: that is what I heard.

verses.pali: “Anātāpī, bhikkhave, bhikkhu anottāpī abhabbo sambodhāya, abhabbo nibbānāya, abhabbo anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya.
verses.english: “Mendicants, without being keen and prudent a mendicant can’t achieve awakening, extinguishment, and the supreme sanctuary from the yoke.

verses.pali: Ātāpī ca kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ottāpī bhabbo sambodhāya, bhabbo nibbānāya, bhabbo anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāyā”ti.
verses.english: But if a mendicant is keen and prudent they can achieve awakening, extinguishment, and the supreme sanctuary from the yoke.”
One who is mindful, alert, meditative,
having cut the fetter of birth and old age,
would experience supreme awakening <j>in this very life.”

verses.pali: Ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti.
verses.english: This too is a matter that was spoken by the Blessed One: that is what I heard.
